'''Zekka Thyne''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] criminal with [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] organization. He could be found in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. He sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill [[Wililikin]] and [[Wedu Belar]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zekka Thyne appears as a non-player characters offering missions in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|Massively Multiplayer Online Roleplaying Game]] (MMORPG) released for the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|pc]].

It can be assumed that Zekka Thyne was intended to be [[Zekka Thyne]], a mixture of Human and an unknown alien species who appeared in ''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]'' and ''[[Side Trip]]''. ''Galaxies'', however, classes him as a Bothan, and his appearance is nothing like that character on which he is based. Thus, it cannot be [[canon]]ically said that the two are the same, though it was most likely the game designer's intention, as ''Galaxies'' possesses several other continuity errors.
